chapter: The union and the 1920s-30s band scene
title: Curtis Moseby and Don Bias
summary: Howard recalls drummer-bandleader Moseby, who was always the boss, and knew Don Bias, who came to town in the late 1930s or early forties.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
